source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Butter — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Butter: refrigerate 1-2 months from date of purchase; freeze 6-9 months from date of purchase. It may be left at room temperature for 1-2 days.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Hard cheese (cheddar, Swiss, parmesan) — refrigerator and freezer storage
content: Hard cheese such as cheddar, Swiss and block parmesan: refrigerate 6 months from date of purchase; after opening, refrigerate 3-4 weeks; freeze 6 months from date of purchase.

source: USDA FoodKeeper (public domain, CC0 1.0) - FSIS FoodKeeper Data v128
title: Granulated sugar — pantry storage
content: Granulated sugar: stores indefinitely in the pantry. Sugar never spoils, but for best quality use within 2 years of opening.

source: Beko Cooker Hood User Manual HCP 61310 XH/BH (manufacturer document, (c) Beko)
title: Range hood — clean the grease filter every month (Beko)
content: Beko cooker hood: the grease filter must be cleaned at least monthly (once a month, 30 days). Wash with non-aggressive detergent, by hand or in the dishwasher on a low temperature and short cycle. A grease filter that is not cleaned is a fire risk.

source: Daikin Room Air Conditioner Operation Manual 3P196326-9B (manufacturer document, (c) Daikin)
title: Air conditioner — clean the air filter every two weeks (Daikin)
content: Daikin room air conditioner: clean the air filters once in about every two weeks (14 days). Clogged air filters cause inefficient operation and waste energy. Remove dust with a vacuum cleaner and gently rinse in cool water, then dry in the shade. Do not operate the air conditioner without filters.
